definitions: Small, finger-like projections that extend into the lumen of the small intestine.
Tiny vascular projections on the fetal side of the placenta.
Any of various small, slender, fingerlike processes or outgrowths on a surface.
examples: The intestinal villi increase the surface area for absorption.
Chorionic villi are used for prenatal diagnosis.
Some plants have villi on their leaves.
